    Normed multiplicative bases along algebra isomorphisms #

    Corollary 5.5(2) (mesh-deformations.tex): "The ray basis transports to a normed multiplicative basis of A." An algebra isomorphism preserves products, idempotents, primitivity and the radical powers, so it transports normed multiplicative bases (HasNormedMultiplicativeBasis.of_algEquiv).
